description.value: Nammos Estiatorio is a modern Greek restaurant on Vancouver's Fraser Street serving traditional Mediterranean dishes family-style, with house-made cocktails and an exclusively Greek wine list. The restaurant has been featured in the Michelin Guide, Montecristo Magazine, and Destination Vancouver, placing it among the city's more acclaimed neighbourhood dining destinations. Dishes span Greek classics from hand-rolled dolmathes and saganaki to grilled octopus and slow-roasted lamb shoulder.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 19m; stands (2 spaces) at 59m; stands (2 spaces) at 94m; stands (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at nammos.ca fully corroborates the OSM contact details (phone 604-428-6850, address 3980 Fraser Street Vancouver BC). The menu confirms vegetarian options explicitly ('MOUSSAKA BEEF OR VEGETARIAN') along with several other plant-forward dishes. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, well-reviewed dine-in restaurant that could serve touring cyclists well, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available website evidence — on-site verification needed.
